pr_title: Use legacy backing index names for data streams in mixed clusters
pr_comments:
cc: @henningandersen on the change to `ReactiveStorageDeciderService` here:

https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/66400/files#diff-4295fc3ce1dcb006cead63e125db2910d0c53cecf7ed2e184e4dc07bd569385aR452

I believe it's fairly trivial and can be removed after the next minor release since it is needed only in mixed clusters to accommodate the change in the naming scheme for data stream backing indices.

issue_context.title: Data stream backing index naming bwc bug
issue_context.body:
If a data stream is created or a rollover happens while the cluster is upgrading from 7.10.1 (or earlier) to 7.11 (or later) then node may fail to accept the cluster state while the cluster consist of nodes of mixed versions.

This is because #65205 introduced a change in the naming of backing indices for data streams and validation of the name of backing indices was relaxed via #65791 (released as part of 7.10.2). These two changes combined can cause this bug.

The fix would be to use the old naming scheme until the minimum node version in the entire cluster is 7.11 or later.

This issue was discovered in CI. 
- https://gradle-enterprise.elastic.co/s/lirh33mwyici2

(not tied to a specific test)

An example of the actual failure in CI:

```
fatal error in thread [elasticsearch[v7.10.2-2][generic][T#7]], exiting
java.lang.AssertionError
	at org.elasticsearch.cluster.metadata.DataStream.<init>(DataStream.java:55)
	at org.elasticsearch.cluster.metadata.DataStream.<init>(DataStream.java:145)
	at org.elasticsearch.cluster.DiffableUtils$DiffableValueReader.read(DiffableUtils.java:688)
	at org.elasticsearch.cluster.DiffableUtils$DiffableValueReader.read(DiffableUtils.java:677)
```

(non-issue, because the #65205 hasn't been released yet)

review_comments: maybe also add a test here with a version before 7.11?
and maybe also a test to `MetadataCreateDataStreamServiceTests` that tests creating a data stream when minimum node version is before 7.11?
